heroSection.heading: Built in New York, shipped everywhere
heroSection.description: Ternary is an engineering institution building digital systems for organizations scaling operations and transforming infrastructure. Based in New York with delivery operations in Dhaka, we operate as technical partners responsible for the systems we design, deliver, and maintain over time.

fundingStory.heading: Bootstrapped and profitable.
fundingStory.description: We answer to the organizations we build for, not to a funding timeline. That independence lets us measure success by durability and operational impact over years—not by launch velocity—and to stay accountable for production code long after it ships.

paras: Ternary builds digital systems designed not just to launch, but to perform reliably and evolve thoughtfully throughout an organization's growth. Our engineers maintain long-horizon responsibility for production code, actively supporting deployments and remaining fully accountable for sustained system performance.
This is software development approached as long-term stewardship—from concepts to launch and legacy to cloud, across product development, enterprise modernization, and engineering augmentation.

ourThesis.heading: Our Thesis
ourThesis.description: We exist to help organizations move from fragmented, legacy, or experimental technology environments to modern, resilient platforms that scale with confidence.

items.title: Engineering as an institution
items.excerpt: Durable systems come from durable capability. We centralize engineering excellence so quality, knowledge, and execution capacity compound over time rather than reset with every project.

items.title: Stewardship over hand-off
items.excerpt: The hardest part of software is not launching it—it is keeping it reliable as the business changes. We stay responsible across the full lifecycle, not just to the go-live date.

items.title: Proximity creates leverage
items.excerpt: We stay close to the users and real-world workflows our systems serve. That context produces better decisions and work that delivers lasting operational impact.

whatWeBelieve.heading: Our Culture
whatWeBelieve.description: Ternary's culture is shaped by the realities of building and sustaining sophisticated systems. We see ourselves not only as builders, but as stewards and enablers of the systems organizations depend on.

items.title: Ownership and stewardship
items.excerpt: We take responsibility for the systems we design, deliver, and operate. Our teams approach engineering as long-term stewardship—with care for reliability, maintainability, and the consequences of decisions over time.

items.title: Transparency and low-noise execution
items.excerpt: We value direct communication, visible progress, and clear escalation when needed. Problems are surfaced early, tradeoffs are made explicit, and execution stays focused on outcomes rather than noise.

items.title: Proximity to users and impact
items.excerpt: We stay close to the people and operations our systems serve. By maintaining proximity to users, clients, and real-world workflows, we build with context and deliver work that has lasting operational impact.

ourApproach.heading: How we operate
ourApproach.description: An engineering partnership model rooted in technical excellence and sustained accountability, defined by three core principles.

items.title: Absolute Ownership
items.excerpt: We take full responsibility for the systems we design and deliver. Our teams approach engineering as continuous stewardship, prioritizing reliability, maintainability, and the long-term consequences of technical decisions.

items.title: Transparent Execution
items.excerpt: We value direct communication and visible progress. Problems are surfaced early, tradeoffs are made explicit, and execution is meticulously focused on delivering measurable outcomes with low internal noise.

items.title: Production Responsibility
items.excerpt: We maintain full production responsibility across the entire system lifecycle—investing in the talent and governance needed to design, deliver, and sustain complex, mission-critical systems.

proofOfScale.heading: Proof of work in the real world
proofOfScale.description: A centralized engineering institution with the certifications, footprint, and disciplined delivery that mission-critical work demands.

company.heading: Systems we've shipped
company.description: From AI revenue platforms to air-gapped LLM deployments and enterprise ERP programs—engineered to launch fast and last.

items.name: Counterfoil Continuum
items.excerpt: An AI revenue operating layer for the experience economy—a modular, API-first, event-driven platform that pairs deterministic rule frameworks with model-assisted recommendations while preserving operator control.

items.name: Turfly
items.excerpt: A sports-facility marketplace pairing Flutter mobile apps with a React portal and FastAPI backend—ML-ranked search, instant booking, and multi-currency payments that reduced booking time by 60% with 95%+ policy compliance.

items.name: LankaBangla Securities
items.excerpt: A governed application layer over an air-gapped open-source LLM for capital markets—control at the infrastructure boundary, usefulness at the workflow boundary, and extensibility at the platform boundary.

leadership.heading: Leadership
leadership.description: We ship the technical and commercial infrastructure that powers modern enterprise, led by a team that operates with total ownership.

members.name: Shadman Shakib
members.story: Founded Ternary to build software as a long-term institution rather than a series of projects—setting the engineering standards and partnership model the firm operates by.

members.name: Sajid Islam
members.story: Leads commercial strategy and client partnerships, aligning technical execution with business objectives across every engagement.

members.name: Shakil Ahmed
members.story: Owns the firm's technical direction—architecture standards, delivery frameworks, and the engineering practices that keep complex systems reliable over time.

members.name: Nahid Reza
members.story: Runs the global delivery hub, turning structured talent development and disciplined execution into consistent, production-grade outcomes at scale.

cta.heading: Construct the future
cta.description: Disciplined thinking. Clear ownership. Rigorous execution. Clarity over complexity, substance over optics, and accountability for outcomes—not just activity. If you are building or modernizing systems that have to last, let's start a conversation.
